apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:d95fb395.description: APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers. Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve. We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager to support and grow our Rider’s Advantage dealer network. In this role, you will take ownership of a region, developing new dealer partnerships, strengthening existing relationships, and driving performance through training, strategy, and hands-on support. This is a high-impact, field-based role for a self-starter who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and driving measurable growth.

assistworld-assist-world:lever:0caca8f9-.description: About the Client Our Client is a New Zealand-based wedding planning platform with an attached vendor marketplace, allowing couples to organise all of their wedding vendors in one place. It was built by the team behind an established sister marketplace, an established marketplace connecting venues, pubs, and bars with musicians, DJs, and entertainers. The founder is hands-on across product development and sales, and is looking for a capable marketing VA to fully own social media execution and email marketing so the business can grow its online presence and vendor base. The Role We are looking for a proactive and creative Social Media & Email Marketing VA to take full ownership of Our Client’s online presence. The ideal candidate is comfortable producing and repurposing content across multiple social platforms, setting up and managing email automations, and conducting targeted vendor outreach on Instagram, all with minimal handholding. This is a part-time role with real growth potential as Our Client scales. Key Responsibilities Social Media Management Create, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Develop engaging static graphics, carousel posts, Stories, Reels, and short-form video content. Repurpose existing content, photography, and video assets into platform-specific content. Write compelling captions, calls-to-action, and platform-optimised copy. Apply Instagram SEO best practices, including keyword optimisation, hashtag research, and audience targeting. Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages, and foster community growth. Maintain content calendars and ensure consistent posting schedules. Monitor trends and recommend content opportunities to increase reach and engagement. Email Marketing Create and manage email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and promotional communications. Build and maintain automated email sequences, workflows, and customer journeys. Manage audience segmentation and subscriber lists. Monitor campaign performance and optimise open rates, click-through rates, and conversions. Ensure all email marketing activities align with brand messaging and marketing objectives. Vendor Outreach & Relationship Building Research and identify potential wedding vendors and industry partners. Conduct outreach through Instagram and other relevant platforms. Build and maintain relationships with prospective vendors and collaborators. Track outreach activity and maintain accurate records. Support marketplace growth through strategic engagement and partnership development. Content Planning & Strategy Assist with monthly content planning and campaign development. Conduct competitor research and market analysis. Identify opportunities to improve social media and email marketing performance. Collaborate with the founder to execute marketing strategies and initiatives. Reporting & Administration Monitor social media and email marketing analytics. Prepare monthly performance reports with actionable insights. Maintain organised digital files, content libraries, and project documentation. Support general marketing administration as required. Tools & Platforms The successful candidate should have experience with some or all of the following: Social Media & Scheduling Instagram Facebook Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Meta Business Suite Buffer Later Hootsuite Design & Content Creation Canva CapCut Adobe Express Email Marketing Brevo (Sendinblue) Mailchimp Klaviyo MailerLite ActiveCampaign ConvertKit Project Management & Collaboration Trello Asana ClickUp Notion Monday.com Analytics & Reporting Google Analytics Google Looker Studio Meta Insights Platform Analytics Administration & Productivity Google Workspace Google Drive Google Docs Google Sheets Microsoft Office Dropbox Requirements Essential Proven experience managing social media accounts professionally. axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:7a31f7c.title: Solutions Engineer
axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:7a31f7c.description: ABOUT US At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home. ABOUT THE ROLE Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets. This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions. At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone. SOLUTIONS ENGINEERING AT AXLE LOOKS LIKE - Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed. - Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms. - Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions. - Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience. - Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements. - Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver. - Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time TECH STACK 🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend 🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility. 🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly ☁️ We deploy on GCP WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. INTERVIEW PROCESS 1. Initial interview 2. Remote pair programming 3. Final interview (in-person) 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:fc36fc30-872.title: Associate & Senior Associate, Mergers & Acquisitions
emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:fc36fc30-872.description: Associate / Senior Associate, M&A, Emergence Software Technologies | Hybrid, Latin America | Full-Time Who We Are Emergence Software Technologies is a software-focused private equity firm investing in operationally critical software businesses in the lower middle market. We are backed by TPO, the private investment firm chaired by Jason Pritzker. Our portfolio spans auto tech, healthcare software, cloud infrastructure, and procurement, and we operate on a long-hold ownership model built for sustained value creation. The Mission Own M&A workstreams end-to-end and carry responsibility for deal outcomes across qualification, underwriting, IC, close, and post-close value creation. What You'll Do - Qualify inbound and intermediary-led opportunities against Emergence's thesis on business model fit, vertical alignment, and financial profile. - Own the financial model end-to-end including LBO structuring, operating projections, scenario analysis, returns attribution, and net working capital normalization. - Lead commercial, financial, and operational diligence workstreams and coordinate third-party advisors across QoE, legal, technology, and market. - Develop investment theses on market sizing, competitive positioning, product stickiness, and management quality, and stress-test assumptions. - Prepare and present IC materials including investment memos, deal summaries, and risk-return analyses. - Manage deal execution from LOI through close, negotiate key terms, and quarterback legal and third-party workstreams to signing. - Support portfolio companies post-close on performance monitoring, value creation initiatives, and add-on acquisitions. - Occasionally support portfolio company finance functions on budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and board-level reporting. What We're Looking For Must-haves - 2 to 5 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, private markets, growth equity, or M&A advisory, including boutique advisory firms supporting PE-backed transactions with software or technology coverage preferred. - Strong LBO modeling and financial analysis skills with comfort across earn-outs, DDTLs, seller notes, and net working capital analysis. - Proven ability to operate on lean teams and manage multiple concurrent processes, ideally across simultaneous client engagements with attention to detail under time pressure. - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to draft IC memos and present to senior stakeholders. - Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a related analytical discipline. Nice-to-haves - Experience evaluating vertical SaaS or operational software businesses and fluency in ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, and churn. - Lower middle market transaction experience on leaner deal teams. - Exposure to Office of the CFO workstreams including financial planning, operational reporting, or interim finance support at PE-backed companies. - CFA candidate or charterholder. - Demonstrated experience coordinating buy-side diligence across QoE vendors, outside counsel, and technical advisors across multiple concurrent workstreams. Who You Are You qualify deals against a thesis before committing team resources, not after. You build models that hold up under stress-testing and flag the assumptions most likely to break. You engage directly with founders and management teams and read them well. You hold a point of view in IC and update it when the data changes. You take ownership of workstreams end-to-end without waiting for handoffs. You think about what happens after close, not just what gets you to signing. You are genuinely curious about how operationally critical software builds and sustains moats. What We Offer - Performance-based bonus tied to deal outcomes and meaningful carry participation - Hybrid role based in Latin America - Full investment lifecycle ownership from day one with a clear pathway to Principal and Partner track

infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT ABOUT EVEREST Everest is a premium, AI-enabled executive operations firm built for founders, executives, and high-net-worth individuals. The people we work with expect support that is proactive, strategic, and discreet. It makes them sharper at the work only they can do, and freer to put their time to its highest and best use. We hold that standard with competence and care. If you're an operator who likes having a hand in how companies, brands, and legacies get built, we'd love to talk. ABOUT THE ROLE The Executive Assistant is a key support partner to our clients, helping them stay focused, organized, and on track. In this role, you’ll work closely with executives to manage schedules, communications, and priorities—providing reliable, thoughtful support that blends a personal touch with smart use of tools and systems. You'll also collaborate with other assistants, sharing ideas and learning as part of a team committed to meaningful, high-quality support. rws-rws:lever:9ab50a7c-0841-457c-b99f-98.title: Social Media Content Evaluator (French)
rws-rws:lever:9ab50a7c-0841-457c-b99f-98.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: France (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 16.5 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in France. Native-level written and spoken fluency in French. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: Aerospace runs on software the rest of the industry stopped buying a decade ago. The system that holds every part design takes six clicks to find a part number. The system that runs the factory floor takes two years to roll out. Most aerospace OEMs have accepted this. We have not. At Boom we are building Boomie — the integrated software platform that connects design, supply chain, manufacturing, and test into one coherent system. It is the digital backbone of how our aircraft and engines get built. We are building it ourselves because the vendors who sell aerospace software stopped innovating before most of our engineers graduated college. We are hiring Senior Full Stack Software Engineers to own domains of Boomie end-to-end. You will sit with the aerospace engineer burning twenty minutes a day copying part numbers between systems, decide what to build, and have it in their hands by the end of the week. You will design APIs that humans and AI agents consume on equal footing, because we have no pre-AI architecture to retrofit. What you'll do Own a domain of Boomie end-to-end — design, supply chain, or manufacturing — from data model through UI Sit with the engineers, techs, and supply chain partners you build for. Build what they actually need. Ship code in your first week. Ship a tool in daily use by the end of your first month. Design for humans and agents as first-class consumers. Build the MCP servers, schemas, and APIs that make Boom's data legible to both. You probably have A track record of building complex systems of systems somewhere serious — CDN, consumer platforms, fintech, ad tech, gaming infrastructure, hard-tech startups, AI-native companies. Domain matters less than instincts. Real range across the stack and founder energy. You can defend an API design and a frontend state decision in the same conversation, and you have a history of taking a blank repo to something users depend on. Fluency with modern AI dev tools and opinions about where they help and where they don't Comfort embedding with non-engineering users and translating their workflows into software You will thrive here if You believe the shop floor and the engineering bullpen are more interesting rooms than the conference room You have strong opinions, held loosely, and you'd rather be proven wrong today than right in six months We are not the right place for engineers who want to configure enterprise software, gather requirements for three months, and ship version one to a stakeholder review board. We are exactly the right place for engineers who want to go home at night knowing the next aircraft or engine will be built faster because of code they wrote. Compensation The Base Salary Range for the Software Engineer position is $130,000 - $175,000 per year. The Base Salary Range for the Senior Software Engineer position is $180,000 - $225,000 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long-term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (ITAR and EAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about ITAR here. Boom is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. Want to build a faster future? Come join Boom.

No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide.
